description: Stop a hosted app's container. The app stays in your account and can be brought back with vibekit_start_app. Use to take an app offline without deleting it.
name: vibekit_stop_app

outputSchema.description: Result envelope: ok=true with data on success, ok=false with error on failure.

data.description: Stop confirmation; the app is retained but the container is freed.

error.description: Error message when ok is false (e.g. missing/invalid VIBEKIT_API_KEY, or an API error).

title: VibeKit Stop App
